 Print this Article 
 View Comments Paul George (left) and the Celtics defeated the Bucks on Wednesday in Boston. Barry Chin/Globe Staff The Celtics will face the Bucks for the second time in less than a week on Sunday. 
 Jayson Tatum had the night off when Boston beat Milwaukee 109-102 on Wednesday at TD Garden, but Paul George scored 25 points and Derrick White had 24 to lead the victory. 
 The matchup shifts to Milwaukee on Sunday for a prime-time game. The Bucks are on a five-game losing streak after suffering an NBA Cup loss to the visiting Raptors on Friday. 
 The Celtics and Bucks will not meet again until the final game of the season for both teams in April. 
 Tyler Herro (23 points, 10 assists) and rookie Brayden Burries (21 points, 11 boards) each posted double-doubles for Milwaukee on Friday. 
 Here’s a preview of Sunday’s game: 
 When: Sunday, 8 p.m. 
 Where: Fiserv Forum, Milwaukee 
 TV: NBCSB. Radio: WBZ-FM 98.5. 
 Line: Boston -13. O/U: 221.0. 
 CELTICS 
 Season record: 7-2. vs. spread: 4-4, 1 push. Over/under: 3-5, 1 push 
 Get Court Sense Keep up with everything Celtics with news, commentary, and analysis from the Globe's all-star team. Arrives twice weekly. Enter Email Sign Up Last 10 games: 7-3. vs. spread: 4-5, 1 push. Over/under: 4-5, 1 push 
 BUCKS 
 Season record: 1-8. vs. spread: 3-6. Over/under: 5-4 
 Last 10 games: 1-9. vs. spread: 3-7. Over/under: 6-4 
 TEAM STATISTICS 
 Points per game: Boston 114.8, Milwaukee 109.7 
 Points allowed per game: Boston 105.1, Milwaukee 122.1 
 Field goal percentage: Boston .452, Milwaukee .434 
 Opponent field goal percentage: Boston .421, Milwaukee .463 
 3-point percentage: Boston .376, Milwaukee .333 
 Opponent 3-point percentage: Boston .337, Milwaukee .351 
 Stat of the day: Boston has won seven of its past eight meetings with Milwaukee, including the last four. 
 Notes: Tatum had 18 points in the first quarter of Friday’s 119-80 NBA Cup trouncing of the host Hornets before finishing with 34 points, nine assists, and eight rebounds. ... Bucks center Myles Turner was held scoreless on 0-of-7 shooting against Toronto on Friday and is averaging a career-low 7.6 points per game. ... Herro is averaging a team-best 22.3 points after being traded from the Heat as part of the blockbuster Giannis Antetokounmpo deal. ... The Celtics are in Philadelphia on Tuesday to face Jaylen Brown and the 76ers.
